email.subject1: a signal play for Total Therapy
email.body1:
Lisette, saw Total Therapy expanding the platform with offline data collection for ABA teams.

Pushing into new capabilities usually means more in-market practices than the team can reach before reps ramp, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Total Therapy off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Lisette, quick follow-up for Total Therapy.

As the platform grows, the pipeline number tends to climb faster than the team can. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter slips.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Total Therapy needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Lisette, last bit of proof for Total Therapy.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Total Therapy's reply rate likely compares to peers in your space. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Lisette, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Running sales and marketing together is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to Total Therapy either way.
